lead.headline: Indian captain, stabbed by his co-pilot, lands the Tel Aviv flight with 174 on board
lead.byline: BBC · CNN · HINDUSTAN TIMES · INDIAN EXPRESS · 1 OCT
lead.short: Wednesday's diverted Dubai to Tel Aviv flight was not a scuffle between pilots: its Omani first officer stabbed Captain Smit Machchhar in an apparent attempt to crash the Boeing 737, which dropped more than 14,000 feet in under 30 seconds. Badly wounded, the Mumbai-born captain opened the cockpit door so passengers could restrain the attacker, then landed at Tabuk in Saudi Arabia. He has had surgery and is stable; the co-pilot is under arrest.
more: Machchhar, who flew for SpiceJet for 11 years before joining the Dubai airline in 2022, has more than 9,750 hours on the 737. Prime Minister Modi called his family and said he had prevented a 9/11-style tragedy; Israel's prime minister called him a true hero and said it is too early to say whether Iran was involved.

why.text: An Indian crew member is why it failed; the case has reopened the debate on cockpit video recorders and who can lock whom out of a flight deck.

facts.cause: co-pilot stabbed captain in apparent crash attempt

seconds.headline: India bowl Sri Lanka out for 45 and meet Pakistan for gold on Saturday
seconds.short: Ishan Kishan's unbeaten 80 and 38 from Vaibhav Sooryavanshi took India to 169 for 7 in Nisshin; Sri Lanka were then dismissed for 45 in 9.5 overs, a 124-run win. Jasprit Bumrah bowled Test-match lengths, Axar Patel sent down 14 dot balls for two wickets, and the innings ended with a team hat-trick.
more: Pakistan beat Bangladesh in the other semi-final, so Saturday's gold-medal match at 10:00 IST is India against Pakistan, their first final against each other this year.

why.text: India v Pakistan for a gold medal, on a Saturday morning: clear the diary for 10:00.

seconds.headline: Gill's unbeaten 223 carries India to their highest ODI chase, 406 in 43.3 overs
seconds.short: India's captain reached 200 in 117 balls, the fastest double hundred in ODI history, and finished on 223 not out from 133 as India won the 2nd ODI in Guwahati by eight wickets to lead the series 2–0. Rohit Sharma made 101 in an opening stand of 255. It was only the second successful 400-plus chase in ODIs, after South Africa's 438 against Australia in 2006.
more: The previous Indian record was 362 for 1 against Australia in Jaipur in 2013. Gautam Gambhir said the pitch made it a batting contest more than a cricket match. The third ODI is in New Chandigarh on Saturday at 14:00 IST.

why.text: The series is won; Saturday's game is the last look at the ODI side before the New Zealand tour.

seconds.headline: Sensex falls 1,000 points to its 2026 low; eight losing weeks, the longest run in 25 years
seconds.byline: BUSINESS STANDARD · ECONOMIC TIMES · NDTV · 1 OCT
seconds.short: The Sensex dropped about 1.4% and the Nifty about 1.6% by the cut, both at their lowest close in three months, wiping roughly ₹9 lakh crore off listed companies. Analysts named the same causes: bets on an RBI rate rise next week, foreign selling, oil near $100 and US 10-year yields at 5.31%, their highest since 2007. The rupee is at its weakest since July.
more: Foreign investors sold a net ₹35,861 crore of Indian shares in September by NSDL's count, ₹10,198 crore of it on the last day. Autos fell hardest after September sales: Bajaj Auto lost about 8% and Maruti 5%. Markets are shut on Friday for Gandhi Jayanti, so today's close settles the week: the Nifty is set for an eighth straight weekly fall.

why.text: A rate rise on 7 October would lift loan EMIs and fixed-deposit rates; the market is already pricing it in.

seconds.headline: PPF stays at 7.1% for a tenth straight quarter; commercial LPG costs ₹67 more in Bengaluru
seconds.short: Rates on small savings schemes are unchanged for October to December: PPF 7.1%, NSC 7.7%, Sukanya Samriddhi and the Senior Citizens' scheme 8.2%, five-year post office deposits 7.5%. Oil companies raised the price of a 19 kg commercial LPG cylinder from 1 October, to ₹2,898 in Bengaluru and ₹2,810 in Delhi; the household 14.2 kg cylinder is unchanged.
more: PPF has been at 7.1% since April 2020. Restaurants and caterers buy commercial cylinders, so the rise reaches eating-out bills, not kitchens at home.

why.text: Nothing changes for your PPF this quarter; check bank FD rates after the RBI decision before locking money away.

briefs.headline: Modi rings Trump as a US law threatens tariffs on buyers of Russian oil
briefs.text: Their first call since Trump signed a law allowing tariffs of up to 100% on countries that keep buying Russian oil or gas covered trade, defence, energy and technology; India placed the call and Modi called it productive.

facts.law: tariffs up to 100% on Russian oil buyers

briefs.headline: Google's Gemini 4 Argon goes first to vetted security teams, not the public
briefs.text: Google says the model can find, check and patch serious software flaws on its own, so early access is limited to its Fairwind group of cyber defenders; developers, businesses and consumers get it later, with no date. Introductory API prices match OpenAI's new Sol: $2 and $10 per million tokens.
